entities.summary: Rishard Andre Matthews is an American former professional football wide receiver. He played college football for the Nevada Wolf Pack and was selected by the Miami Dolphins in the seventh round of the 2012 NFL draft. Matthews was also a member of the Tennessee Titans, New York Jets, and New Orleans Saints.
